description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to facilitate interactions with the PerformanceReview entity, such as setting related entities and retrieving formatted date properties and status descriptions.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the PerformanceReview entity, providing helper methods to access and manipulate performance review data with formatted outputs and related entity management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceReview entity instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on the PerformanceReview based on employee number.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle entity on the PerformanceReview based on job title ID.

methods.name: getSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer designated as the supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer designated as the employee.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the start date of the review period formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the end date of the review period formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the completion date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getStatusName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status name based on the Status ID of the performance review.
